objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has utilized wmic to execute commands on victim devices.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also leveraged WMI to enumerate volumes and drives.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
